scripts.audio: node audio/synth.mjs && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i audio/soundtrack.wav -c:a aac -b:a 192k audio/soundtrack.m4a
scripts.render: npm run -s render:en && npm run -s render:ja
scripts.render:en: npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.77 render --quality high --workers 4 --output renders/master.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i renders/master.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slower -crf 23 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -movflags +faststart -c:a copy showreel.mp4
scripts.render:ja: npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.77 render --quality high --workers 4 --variables '{"lang":"ja"}' --output renders/master-ja.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i renders/master-ja.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slower -crf 23 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -movflags +faststart -c:a copy showreel-ja.mp4
